title: Arc B — four sequential acts, each with its reason (D9, D11)

acts.label: Pregrade
acts.trigger: LLM-vision identify as a proof of concept — feasibility and a baseline before image-to-image

acts.label: Live-stream scout
acts.trigger: image-to-image identify — a card is on screen for seconds; 6–15s breaks “feels live”

acts.label: Bulk scan / lots
acts.trigger: one shared identify core, fast and accurate for BOTH bulk scan and scout — every app tested was slow and inaccurate, and identify was the hardest part; solve it once, build both apps around it
acts.detail: image-to-image lane 08-20 · scout switched to it 09-02 · LLM identify retired 09-03

acts.label: Comps / pricing
acts.trigger: raw comps across NM / LP / MP / HP / DMG became its own problem, outgrowing “use an API”
acts.detail: precursor: per-condition tiers shipped 08-23, inside lots

caption: Four sequential acts, each begun for a stated reason (D9). Act 3 and act 4 framings settled by the founder (D11), superseding the earlier open questions.
